notes: Both articles governing a noun with a following free genitive pronoun (τὸν ἄγγελόν μου, τὴν ὁδόν σου) are emptied under rule 20 proper; the article before Ἠσαΐᾳ is emptied under rule 23.
καθώς → *Even as* is headed on *as*, rule 82 recording *even as* as an ordinary rendering of the comparative adverb where no correlative competes.
